subject: FinTechCo - Deployment mode & integration follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@fintechco.com>, Ben Whitman <ben.whitman@fintechco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinTechCo - Deployment mode & integration follow-up

Hi Sarah / Ben —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can scope any Dedicated vs Private requirements: 

Call recap
- Primary concern: security/compliance constraints that will determine whether FinTechCo needs Private (VPC / on-prem) vs Redwood Dedicated.
- Items called out by your security team: SSO (SAML/Okta), customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM integration), and long-term logging retention & export to your SIEM (7+ years).
- Traffic & throughput: pilot will be ~50 reqs/s during peak; model: open LLM (Llama-2 variant) for customer messages.

What we propose
1) Technical scoping call with our Solutions Engineer to validate SAML and KMS/HSM support and network topology (VPC peering or private link).
2) We’ll surface a short checklist for procurement/security (SOC2 docs, encryption details, network diagrams).
3) Share one-pager on Dedicated vs Private to outline tradeoffs (cost, SLA, integration effort).

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_vs_Private_onepager.pdf (attached), SAML_integration_guide.pdf (attached), SOC2_Audit_Summary.pdf (attached).

Please let me know what times would work for a 45–60 min technical scoping session this week or next.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Whitman <ben.whitman@fintechco.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTechCo - Deployment mode & integration follow-up

Thanks Marissa —

Helpful recap. A couple clarifications from our security and infra teams: 

- Our preference leans toward Private (VPC or on-prem) because we need HSM-backed key stores for customer PII encryption. Can Dedicated support customer-managed CMK that are HSM-backed? From the quick review it looks like Dedicated supports CMKs but not HSM integration; can you confirm?
- SSO: we use Okta / SAML 2.0 for all admin access and will need SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. We also want SCIM provisioning for user roles.
- Logging: we have a 7-year retention requirement for certain audit logs and want continuous export to our Splunk instance (or S3 archive if needed). Is long-term log retention/export possible with Dedicated or only with Private?

Also can you share a rough timeline & cost delta between Dedicated and Private for an initial pilot? Procurement will need rough numbers to fast-track approvals.

Ben — looping you in for any additional compliance asks.

Best,
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Platform
FinTechCo

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@fintechco.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTechCo - Deployment mode & integration follow-up

Sarah —

Thanks for the details, that helps a lot. Looping in Priyom (Solutions Engineer) and Vivek (Sales Engineering lead) to coordinate the technical scoping and to confirm KMS/HSM capabilities. 

Quick answers up front (will validate on the tech call):
- CMK / KMS/HSM: Redwood Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (CMK) for disk and model encryption. HSM-backed key material is typically available with our Private VPC/on-prem offering; we can discuss HSM integration patterns on the call and provide options (bring-your-own-HSM vs cloud KMS with HSM).
- SSO: SAML 2.0 (Okta) and SCIM provisioning are supported in both Dedicated and Private; we’ll confirm exact attribute mappings and admin role sync during the tech call.
- Logging retention & export: Dedicated offers real-time log streaming to customer-managed endpoints (e.g., Splunk, S3) but long-term retention (multi-year, archival to customer-controlled HSM/S3 buckets) is easiest to guarantee with Private. We can provide an export pipeline pattern that works for Dedicated for the pilot, and a Private-specific architecture for 7+ year retention.

Next steps:
1) Priyom to schedule a 45–60 min scoping call to validate your KMS/HSM requirements and network topology (VPC, peering, private link).
2) I’ll share a two-slide cost delta summary (pilot Dedicated vs Private) and a procurement checklist.
3) If the scoping call confirms Private is needed, we’ll prepare an initial Statement of Work and timeline for a Private deployment pilot.

Info we’ll need on the call:
- Okta SAML metadata & SCIM endpoint (we won’t need credentials on the call, but metadata files would speed things up).
- High-level network diagram and whether you prefer VPC peering or private link.
- Encryption requirements: need to know if HSM is mandatory or cloud-KMS with HSM-backed CMKs is acceptable.

Attaching the one-pager and SAML guide again. Priyom / Vivek — can you propose times below?

Times we can do: Thu 4/9 10:00–11:00 PT, Thu 4/9 14:00–15:00 PT, Fri 4/10 09:00–10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
